name: v3_cno_wave
_comment: CONTROL (out of scope). CNO RPB WaveData_64x64_IN.h5, groups Sample_*_t_5 (first 1000 in numeric order): input = initial condition u0, output = u(t=5). Wave equation u_tt = c^2 Laplace(u), c = 0.1, exact sine-series solution on 64 x 64 (Raonic et al. 2023, SM C.3.2). Time-dependent. A user's most plausible reading for a diffusion linter: source = input, u = output.
